factual_observations: DDM-Net baseline achieves 24.80% Macro F1 at 0.5s tolerance on Chuyen 1 sewing operations, ranking 3rd behind EfficientGEBD (57.60%) and DiffGEBD (40.77%).
The model is heavily false-negative dominated: it emitted only 168 total predictions for 445 ground-truth boundaries (37.8% prediction density).
Precision (45.24% at 0.5s, scaling to 69.64% at 1.0s) is significantly higher than recall (17.08% at 0.5s), indicating that emitted detections are relatively reliable but highly conservative.
On videos with dense repetitive sewing boundaries (cd8_chuyen2, cd6_chuyen2, cd12_chuyen1, cd19_chuyen3), recall drops below 15.0% due to peak suppression or strict classification thresholding.
